title: US Army calls Iowa lead detonation a ‘huge success’ and says threat of spontaneous explosions has been ‘eliminated’ – as it happened
summary_full: This live blog is now closed. For the latest news on this detonation in Iowa, read our full story:Smoke seen from a mile away as army detonates bomb-making chemicalsThe United States Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) has activated an emergency response to support the Iowa Department of Health and Human Services to “provide accurate public health communication and technical assistance to our state and federal partners.”In a statement, the CDC said that at the request of the state of Iowa, it will support the state’s health department to develop “recommendations to help protect people from potential exposure to lead and air pollution” and in preparing to support the state with any “any post-event community health assessment needs.” Continue reading...
